Dear Hazel,
Our youth theatre tried written captions at yesterday’s rehearsal. We thought a screen behind the actors would be easy to read. In fact, some audience members kept moving their eyes between the actors and the screen and missed small gestures. We then placed two smaller screens closer to the sides of the stage. The same words appeared on both, so viewers could choose the nearer one. This helped, but the captions sometimes changed too late. We will adjust their timing before inviting the public. The actors will keep speaking; the captions will support the performance rather than replace it.
Love,
Max
